thread:
sophie: Quick thread  small copy pass for the site: hero lines for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, a short webinar pitch we can use in posts, and the lead routing rules. Need something concise and testable.

marta: Thinking three short single-line headlines that each communicate a clear customer outcome. Keep verbs active.

gabe: Raw headlines (one-liners):
- Hosted: 'Go from model to product — production inference in minutes'
- Dedicated: 'Reserve capacity. Hit SLAs. Scale predictably.'
- Private: 'Inference inside your network, with enterprise controls'
These avoid fluff and map to funnels.

olivia: For webinar social copy: 'Join our live benchmark: latency, cost per token, and a guided rollout demo.' Add a concrete stat only if Ops confirms numbers. Two snappy variants for testing: short tweet style and a longer email headline.

patrick: CTA experiments (single-button text variations): Hosted = 'Start free', Hosted alt = 'Try the API' ; Dedicated = 'Request pilot', Dedicated alt = 'Book capacity review' ; Private = 'Request demo', Private alt = 'Talk to security'. Map each to the right funnel.

ken: Routing rules for Growth (simple snippet to paste into form workflows):

```
if form.interest == "hosted": assign -> sdr-hosted
elif form.interest == "dedicated": assign -> sdr-dedicated
elif form.interest == "private": assign -> sdr-enterprise
if utm_source contains "webinar": add_tag -> webinar-regist
if interest == "private" and company_size >= 500: set_flag -> needs-compliance-review
hidden_field: benchmark_pdf_opt_in = true
```

lauren: Also recommend capturing 'primary_use_case' on the form (values: chat, embeddings, search, other) to route to vertical SDRs later. And set 'region' to avoid shipping latency numbers in APAC pages.

marta: Microcopy for feature bullets under each hero (3 bullets):
- 'Workload-aware batching & KV caching to lower unit cost'
- 'Variant routing for graceful fallbacks'
- 'Token-level observability and rollout controls'
For Dedicated, move 'reserved capacity & SLA' to the top.

sophie: Webinar narrative idea for the landing modal: lead with a real customer scenario (e.g., chat app scaling), show before/after metrics (latency and cost), then a 10-minute demo of rollouts. Keep it narrative-first, numbers second.

gabe: One-paragraph teaser for the webinar modal/email:
'See how an app serving conversational users cut token costs and improved tail latency by tuning batching, caching, and routing policies. Well run the live benchmark and walk through a safe rollout into production.'

olivia: Suggest we A/B test two modal CTAs: 'Reserve spot' vs 'Get benchmark PDF' (one is more conversion-focused, other captures lead quality).

patrick: Owners: marta to finalize hero lines, gabe to update Dedicated bullets, ken to confirm any metrics before we publish, lauren to add form fields to Growth. I'll update the Growth routing snippet once fields are live.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: copy-pass/launch-webinar-hero -> staging at 2024-10-16T02:00Z :white_check_mark:

sophie: Great. I'll draft the PR with the three headlines, bullets, webinar teaser, form routing snippet, and CTAs. Tagging folks for review before deploy. Thanks! :thumbsup:
